quote: Form is emptiness, emptiness is form; form does not differ from emptiness, emptiness does not differ from form.
author: Prajñāpāramitā Hṛdaya

quote: Whatever is dependently co-arisen, that is explained to be emptiness. That, being a dependent designation, is itself the middle way.
author: Nāgārjuna

quote: Appearances and mind are non-dual; when mind is recognized as unborn, appearance is freed into its own nature.
author: Virūpa

quote: Bodhi originally has no tree in it, nor does the clear mirror have any stand. Originally there is not a single thing—where could any dust alight?
author: Huineng (Sixth Patriarch)

quote: The Tao that can be told is not the eternal Tao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name.
author: Laozi

quote: That which is not seen by the eye, but by which the eyes see: know that alone to be Brahman, not what people worship here.
author: Vedic Rṣis

quote: You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions.
author: Krishna

quote: The eye through which I see God is the same eye through which God sees me; my eye and God's eye are one eye, one seeing, one knowing, one love.
author: Meister Eckhart

quote: The kingdom of God is within you and all around you, not in buildings of wood and stone.
author: Gospel of Thomas

quote: He who knows himself knows his Lord.
author: Ibn Arabi

quote: The unexamined life is not worth living.
author: Socrates (via Plato)

quote: Everything that exists exists in God, and without God nothing can be or be conceived.
author: Baruch Spinoza

quote: Never did eye see the sun on a condition of becoming not sun-like; nor can any soul see beauty without being itself beautiful.
author: Plotinus

quote: Do not let the future disturb you. You will face it, if you have to, with the same weapons of reason which today arm you against the present.
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: As above, so below; as within, so without; as the universe, so the soul.
author: Hermes Trismegistus
